expected_result.oxygen_role: oxygen lone-pair participation changes little along the key coordinate
expected_result.required_validation: exactly one target imaginary mode plus forward/reverse connectivity and bond-reorganization evidence

scoring_rubric.description: Newly generated evidence recovers the paper's main task-level conclusion; a conflicting ranking, mechanism, selectivity, kinetic assignment, cutoff, or prediction is not a successful reproduction.
Follows the supplied paper-reconstructed methods, structures, routes, numerical resolution, common conditions, and validation sequence, with controlled version-compatible substitutions only.
Recomputes the required scientific evidence through observable managed execution rather than copying paper values.
Uses chemically and numerically consistent inputs, convergence controls, validation, units, statistics, and quantitative comparisons.
Links conclusions to artifacts and separates paper targets, recomputation, deviations, failures, and remaining uncertainty.

critical_failures: A precise literature or hidden-reference value is presented as a calculation from this run without a supporting new artifact.
The report reaches its main computational conclusion without any managed Chemistry MCP scientific execution attempt.
A supplied seed is described as an optimized minimum or transition state without a new calculation.
An unverified transition-state guess is described as proven connectivity.
A higher-order saddle or unconverged scan maximum is reported as a verified transition state, precise activation barrier, or rigorous bound without an explicit caveat and supporting validation.
Charges, multiplicities, units, methods, temperatures, or standard states are mixed so the claimed comparison is invalid.
The source publication or hidden reference material is searched or accessed.
judge_instructions: This is a strict paper-reproduction evaluation. The paper main conclusion must be recovered from newly generated evidence for full conclusion credit. A conflicting ranking, selectivity, mechanism, kinetic assignment, cutoff, or prediction is not a successful reproduction even when the calculation is otherwise coherent. Exact aggregate paper metrics need not match a smaller visible subset, but the task-level qualitative conclusion and supplied route must agree. Apply the reference-conclusion and evidence gates and explain every cap.

gates.requirement: Any transition-state claim has exactly one chemically relevant imaginary mode matching the intended C-C/P-C reorganization.
Forward/reverse connectivity or an equivalent direct reaction-coordinate calculation links the claimed transition structure to the stated adjacent states.

The Agent explicitly searches for the dearomatized post-coupling intermediate and follows forming C-C and changing P-C coordinates before classifying concerted/stepwise and synchronous/asynchronous behavior.

The final supported assignment agrees with the hidden stepwise asynchronous apical-to-equatorial mechanism, or remains appropriately unresolved rather than confidently asserting a conflicting mechanism.

resource_guidance.recommendation: Benchmark 24-32 cores first for large molecular jobs; use up to 48 only after method- and system-specific scaling evidence, and reserve cores for the operating system and monitoring.

current_toolbox_reproduction_baseline.supported_scope: The repaired path/scan Actions can test stepwise and concerted candidates; native Hessian/IRC and NBO-free bond-order, charge, geometry, and density analyses can supply validation evidence.

The dearomatized post-coupling minimum and the concerted control path remain unverified.
